image_description: A close-up, top-down view of three disposable lighters arranged side-by-side on a pink surface. The central lighter is encased in clear plastic packaging and features a red base with a black-and-white checkered pattern wrapped around the fuel reservoir. To the left is a red lighter with a cartoon character design (partially visible text 'IVE'). To the right is a cream-colored lighter with red accents and a graphic design. All objects appear to be standard Bic-style disposable lighters.
